scope: synthetic palette development/validation; no publication generalisation
partitions: 28 bases per split, 3 derivatives each; derivatives remain with base
ordinary: all generated palette/layout/variant cases remain in coverage denominator
recogniser_inputs: supplied counts and numeric endpoints only; no palette, truth colours, ROIs or truth selection
manual_geometry_mode: separate diagnostic experiment with known full ROIs and plotted truth
qc: retain previous candidate-span thresholds; components are diagnostics, not permission to accept
historical: corrections validation is inspected development regression; reports preserved
